verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic capture of clicks, pageviews, or form interactions as analytics events. Product analytics docs describe custom events you capture from an SDK. The AI wizard generates per-event tracking code for you, which is a different mechanism from autocapture. Session replay records sessions for playback rather than ingesting interaction events. None of these counts as the capability in this story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can capture clicks, pageviews, and form interactions automatically without writing tracking code for each event
